lines.t: Eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh
Storms breakin' shadows try to pull me under Whispers in the night but I'm runnin' like thunder
Fears risin' up but your name is my armor Every step I take you make me stronger
I hear the lights tryna chain me down But your truth cuts through every sound
When the world shakes, I won't bow You lift me up, I'm standing now
When the battle rips, I stand in the fire Cause you're the one who lifts me higher
Every weapon formed will fall at your feet Your light breaks in and it rescues me
I'm unbroken, unafraid, set free I rise again where your light finds me
Winds howl, but your peace is louder Door tries to drown me, but you got the power
No turning back, I'm a new creation Moving in the strength of your salvation
I hear the doubt trying to drag me down But your love shakes the battleground
When the night hits, I won't hide you
Pull me through to the other side
When the battle hits, I stand in the fire
Cause you're the one who lifts me higher
Every weapon formed will fall at your feet
Your light breaks in and it rescues me
I'm unbroken and afraid, set free
I'll rise again where your light finds me
I won't run, I won't break
You are the light no darkness can take
In the storm, in the flames
You call my heart by my name
When the battle hits, I stand in the fire
Cause you're the one who lifts me higher
Every fear I had is lost in your peace
Your voice calls out and it strengthens me
I'm unbroken, unafraid, set free
I'll rise again where your light finds me
